faqs.question: What is a dual plate check valve?
faqs.answer: A dual plate check valve uses two spring-loaded semicircular plates hinged on a central pin to allow forward flow and close rapidly against reverse flow. The split-plate design halves closing travel versus a single-disc swing check, greatly reducing water-hammer severity on pump shut-off.

faqs.question: What are the advantages over a swing check valve?
faqs.answer: Dual plate check valves are shorter and lighter (API 594 face-to-face is far less than swing-check equivalents), close faster to limit reverse-flow surge, and can be installed in any orientation — horizontal, vertical upward or vertical downward.

faqs.question: What pressure classes are available?
faqs.answer: ASME Class 150, 300 and 600. Engineering data are pending; contact Precise Engineers with your line pressure, temperature and medium for the correct body and trim selection.

faqs.question: Which standard governs dual plate check valves?
faqs.answer: Design, testing and dimensions to API 594. Face-to-face per ASME B16.10. Pressure-temperature ratings per ASME B16.34.

faqs.question: What body and trim materials are available?
faqs.answer: Body in WCB, CF8M, CF8, LCC or WC6. Plates in SS 316 or SS 304; springs in SS 316 or Inconel 625 for high-temperature service. Precise Engineers is ISO 9001:2015 certified and EIL approved.
